narrative: Our analysis of the backdoors used in the September 2018 attacks show that AuditCred.dll/ROptimizer.dll was similarly used: FileTokenBroker.dll (2017 att AuditCred.dll/Roptimizer.dll (2018 ack) attack). With capabilities like web/URL filtering, behavioral analysis, and custom sandboxing, XGen security protects against today’s threats that bypass traditional controls; exploit known, unknown, or undisclosed vulnerabilities; either steal or encrypt personally identifiable data; or conduct malicious cryptocurrency mining. Once the backdoor is loaded, it will then load the [REDACTED_MALWARE] configuration file Auditcred.dll.mui/rOptimizer.dll.mui to extract the C&C information and connect to it.
